samples.text: Iran continues to expand its nuclear activity, in violation of its international commitments. Incredible new technologies like artificial intelligence are being deployed for military use without agreed rules. Those are difficult challenges to grasp, and they are too urgent to ignore. That is why the new Pact for the Future (resolution 79/1) is so important. We must put new energy and creativity into conflict resolution and conflict prevention, reverse the trend towards ever-greater violence, make the institutions of peace fit for purpose and hold members to their commitments under the Charter.
